alt.text: or 100,000 standing at Cephalon Simaris, if you already lost a copy

conditions: No blueprint and no crafting; it arrives with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.
The Drifter stops wielding it in the story afterwards, but it stays in your inventory.

disclosures.title: levelling for Mastery
disclosures.body: Level it to 30 once. A Survival or Eximus-heavy mission is quick; one player maxed it in a single Survival run. If the UI shows it unmaxed after maxing, check the profile Mastery number, then Forma and level it again before filing a ticket.
